description_en: Modifies the China mainland network access optimization configuration for a site
description_zh: 修改站点中国大陆网络接入优化配置
name: UpdateCrossBorderOptimization

parameters.description_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable China mainland network access optimization. This feature is disabled by default. Valid values:

- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.
parameters.description_zh:
是否开启中国大陆网络接入优化，默认关闭。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
